scenes.title: A tiny 1% fee can cost you $187K
scenes.say: A tiny one percent fee could cost you almost two hundred thousand dollars.

scenes.label: invested for 30 years
scenes.say: Say you invest one hundred thousand for thirty years.

scenes.title: After 30 years
scenes.say: At seven percent, it grows to seven sixty one thousand. Lose one percent to fees, and it's only five seventy four.
